newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila banks sell T-bills on expected rate hike.
newsitem.headline: Manila banks sell T-bills on expected rate hike.

text.p: Philippine banks were lightening up their Treasury bill portfolios on Wednesday in anticipation of further increases in domestic rates, traders said.
They said the Thai baht troubles may extend for some more months, thus putting pressures on the Philippine peso which could force the Central Bank to raise interest rates to ward off speculators.
Secondary trading was limited to short-term bills to service the investment requirements of banks' clients, traders added.
"Only the short term is moving if none at all," a dealer said.
